::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Jeremiah calls Judah to repentance while announcing both coming judgment and the promise of a New Covenant. The book teaches that God's faithfulness endures despite His people's rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Jeremiah 1:5
Before I formed thee in the womb I knew thee
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's most famous verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jeremiah's call as a prophet. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign purpose and commissioning of His servant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Jeremiah 2:13
Broken cisterns
### Why This Verse Powerful image of spiritual apostasy ### Chapter Insight This chapter confronts Judah's spiritual adultery. The key verse highlights the tragedy of abandoning God, the source of living water. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Jeremiah 3:15
Shepherds after Mine own heart
### Why This Verse Promise of godly leadership ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls the nation to repentance despite persistent unfaithfulness. The key verse reveals God's willingness to restore the repentant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Jeremiah 4:14
Wash thine heart from wickedness
### Why This Verse Call to repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns of coming judgment from the north. The key verse urges genuine repentance rather than superficial religion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Jeremiah 5:21
Hear now this, O foolish people
### Why This Verse Spiritual blindness ### Chapter Insight This chapter exposes Judah's widespread corruption. The key verse demonstrates that judgment comes when truth and righteousness are rejected. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Jeremiah 6:16
Ask for the old paths
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted call to faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns of Jerusalem's impending destruction. The key verse calls God's people to seek the ancient paths of righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Jeremiah 7:23
Obey My voice
### Why This Verse Covenant obedience ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Jeremiah's Temple Sermon. The key verse warns against trusting religious rituals while neglecting obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Jeremiah 8:22
Is there no balm in Gilead?
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's most quoted questions ### Chapter Insight This chapter laments Judah's refusal to repent. The key verse highlights the people's rejection of God's wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Jeremiah 9:23
Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom
### Why This Verse True grounds for boasting ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts human boasting with knowing God. The key verse teaches that true glory is found in understanding and knowing the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Jeremiah 10:23
The way of man is not in himself
### Why This Verse Dependence on God ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the living God with idols. The key verse proclaims God's uniqueness and sovereignty over creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Jeremiah 11:8
They obeyed not, nor inclined their ear
### Why This Verse Covenant rebellion ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses Judah's violation of the covenant. The key verse emphasizes the consequences of covenant unfaithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Jeremiah 12:5
If thou hast run with the footmen
### Why This Verse Perseverance under greater trials ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jeremiah's questions about God's justice. The key verse encourages perseverance despite difficult circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Jeremiah 13:23
Can the Ethiopian change his skin?
### Why This Verse Human inability to reform itself ### Chapter Insight This chapter uses symbolic actions to illustrate Judah's pride. The key verse reveals that pride prevents people from honoring God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Jeremiah 14:9
Yet Thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us
### Why This Verse Appeal for mercy ### Chapter Insight This chapter records prayers during a devastating drought. The key verse emphasizes dependence upon God as the only true source of hope. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Jeremiah 15:16
Thy words were found, and I did eat them
### Why This Verse Beloved verse on God's Word ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains God's response to Jeremiah's complaints. The key verse calls for faithful endurance in ministry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Jeremiah 16:19
O LORD, my strength and my fortress
### Why This Verse Hope among the nations ### Chapter Insight This chapter portrays the severity of coming judgment. The key verse points beyond judgment to future restoration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Jeremiah 17:9
The heart is deceitful above all things
### Why This Verse One of the most cited verses in Jeremiah ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts trusting in humanity with trusting in God. The key verse describes the blessing of placing confidence in the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Jeremiah 18:6
As the clay is in the potter's hand
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's defining images ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the potter and the clay. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign right to shape nations and individuals. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Jeremiah 19:11
So will I break this people
### Why This Verse Symbolic judgment ### Chapter Insight This chapter uses a broken vessel to symbolize Judah's coming destruction. The key verse illustrates the consequences of persistent rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Jeremiah 20:9
His word was in mine heart as a burning fire
### Why This Verse Famous description of prophetic calling ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jeremiah's persecution and discouragement. The key verse reveals the irresistible power of God's word within His servant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Jeremiah 21:8
I set before you the way of life and death
### Why This Verse Choice and accountability ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces Jerusalem's unavoidable judgment. The key verse calls people to choose the path of life through submission to God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Jeremiah 22:29
O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD
### Why This Verse Dramatic prophetic appeal ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses Judah's kings and leaders. The key verse emphasizes justice, righteousness, and care for the vulnerable. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Jeremiah 23:29
Is not My word like a fire?
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter condemns false shepherds and promises a righteous King. The key verse points to the coming Messiah, the righteous Branch. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Jeremiah 24:7
I will give them a heart to know Me
### Why This Verse Promise of restoration ### Chapter Insight This chapter uses the vision of good and bad figs. The key verse distinguishes those whom God will restore from those facing judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Jeremiah 25:11
These nations shall serve Babylon seventy years
### Why This Verse Key exile prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes Jeremiah's message and predicts seventy years of exile. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty over nations and history. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Jeremiah 26:13
Amend your ways and your doings
### Why This Verse Call to repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter records opposition to Jeremiah's preaching. The key verse highlights the courage required to proclaim God's truth faithfully. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Jeremiah 27:5
I have made the earth
### Why This Verse God's sovereign authority ### Chapter Insight This chapter uses a yoke to symbolize Babylon's dominance. The key verse calls the nations to submit to God's appointed discipline. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Jeremiah 28:9
When the word of the prophet comes to pass
### Why This Verse Test of a true prophet ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts true and false prophecy through Hananiah. The key verse emphasizes that God's word will ultimately prove true. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Jeremiah 29:11
I know the plans I have for you
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in the Bible ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Jeremiah's letter to the exiles. The key verse encourages trust in God's future plans despite present hardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Jeremiah 30:17
I will restore health unto thee
### Why This Verse Restoration promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises Israel's future restoration. The key verse points to God's covenant faithfulness beyond judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Jeremiah 31:3
I have loved thee with an everlasting love
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's greatest promises ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces the New Covenant. The key verse promises God's law written upon the heart. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Jeremiah 32:17
There is nothing too hard for Thee
### Why This Verse Famous declaration of faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jeremiah's purchase of a field during the siege. The key verse demonstrates faith in God's promise of future restoration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Jeremiah 33:3
Call unto Me, and I will answer thee
### Why This Verse Widely quoted prayer promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises the restoration of Jerusalem and David's line. The key verse reaffirms God's covenant with David and His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Jeremiah 34:15
You had done right in My sight
### Why This Verse Covenant accountability ### Chapter Insight This chapter condemns Judah's failure to honor its covenant obligations. The key verse highlights the seriousness of breaking promises before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Jeremiah 35:19
Jonadab shall not want a man to stand before Me
### Why This Verse Rechabite faithfulness rewarded ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts Judah's disobedience with the faithfulness of the Rechabites. The key verse commends steadfast obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Jeremiah 36:23
The king cut it with a penknife
### Why This Verse Rejection of God's word ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the burning of Jeremiah's scroll. The key verse demonstrates that God's word cannot be destroyed by human opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Jeremiah 37:17
Is there any word from the LORD?
### Why This Verse Zedekiah's secret inquiry ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jeremiah's imprisonment during Jerusalem's siege. The key verse highlights faithful proclamation despite rejection. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Jeremiah 38:6
They cast Jeremiah into the dungeon
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's most memorable events ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jeremiah's rescue from a cistern. The key verse emphasizes the cost of speaking God's truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Jeremiah 39:18
Because thou hast put thy trust in Me
### Why This Verse Deliverance through faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Jerusalem's fall. The key verse demonstrates the fulfillment of God's warnings through the prophets. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Jeremiah 40:4
See, all the land is before thee
### Why This Verse Aftermath of Jerusalem's fall ### Chapter Insight This chapter records events following Jerusalem's destruction. The key verse reveals God's continued care for a remnant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 41
Jeremiah 41:17
They departed to go into Egypt
### Why This Verse Continued instability ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the assassination of Gedaliah. The key verse illustrates the tragic consequences of political violence and distrust. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 42
Jeremiah 42:6
Whether it be good or evil, we will obey
### Why This Verse Promise later broken ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the people's request for guidance. The key verse highlights the importance of obeying God after seeking His will. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 43
Jeremiah 43:7
They obeyed not the voice of the LORD
### Why This Verse Rebellion continues ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Judah's disobedient flight to Egypt. The key verse demonstrates the danger of rejecting God's clear direction. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 44
Jeremiah 44:17
We will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our own mouth
### Why This Verse Defiant apostasy ### Chapter Insight This chapter rebukes continued idolatry in Egypt. The key verse reveals the persistence of rebellion despite judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 45
Jeremiah 45:5
Seekest thou great things for thyself? Seek them not
### Why This Verse Famous personal admonition ### Chapter Insight This chapter offers encouragement to Baruch. The key verse teaches contentment and trust amid difficult times. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 46
Jeremiah 46:27
Fear not, O Jacob My servant
### Why This Verse Hope amid judgment ### Chapter Insight This chapter prophesies judgment against Egypt. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty over powerful nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 47
Jeremiah 47:6
O thou sword of the LORD
### Why This Verse Memorable prophetic image ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon the Philistines. The key verse emphasizes that no nation stands outside God's authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 48
Jeremiah 48:10
Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted warning ### Chapter Insight This chapter pronounces judgment against Moab. The key verse warns against pride and self-confidence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 49
Jeremiah 49:16
The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee
### Why This Verse Judgment on Edom ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains prophecies against several nations. The key verse demonstrates God's rule over all peoples and kingdoms. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 50
Jeremiah 50:6
My people have been lost sheep
### Why This Verse One of Jeremiah's most quoted metaphors ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells Babylon's downfall. The key verse reveals God's justice against oppressive empires. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 51
Jeremiah 51:10
The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness
### Why This Verse Hope of vindication ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues the prophecy of Babylon's destruction. The key verse assures that God will vindicate His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 52
Jeremiah 52:31
Evil-merodach lifted up the head of Jehoiachin
### Why This Verse Hopeful conclusion ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jerusalem's fall and the exile. The key verse concludes the book by affirming the historical fulfillment of God's word while preserving hope through Jehoiachin's release. :::
